headline: Ministry of External Affairs Hires Professional Calligrapher to Decode ‘Value’ of Historic Ties
body:
The Ministry of External Affairs has officially commissioned a team of master calligraphers and ancient linguists to interpret the precise geometric value of India’s historical ties with foreign nations, following a recent diplomatic greeting from a global head of state that described the relationship as ‘valuable.’ The task force is currently analyzing the scroll length and ink density of the message to determine if ‘valuable’ equates to a mid-sized trade surplus or simply a very polite emoji exchange.

“We are treating this as a high-level diplomatic puzzle,” said Joint Secretary of Diplomatic Semantics, Rajesh Varma, who is overseeing the project from a makeshift office in South Block. “Is it a ‘gold-standard’ valuable or a ‘sentimental-gift-from-a-distant-relative’ valuable? We need to know before we draft our response, which will be hand-delivered on parchment made of recycled policy drafts.”

The department has already rejected three initial drafts of the reply, citing a lack of ‘historical gravitas’ and insufficient flowery adjectives. Sources suggest the final response will likely include a mention of the shared fondness for spiced tea and long, complicated administrative procedures, ensuring the ‘valuable’ status remains firmly in place for at least another three to five business days.
caption: MEA leaves nothing to chance as they decode the exact market price of 'valuable' diplomatic relations. Are we talking precious metals or just good vibes? #Diplomacy #IndiaIran #Geopolitics #MEA (satire)
